questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: To be able to speak german in order to improve my language abilities.

questions.answer: Not really any, I joined some of the student activities and met people who were also starting their exchange.

questions.answer: Off campus

questions.answer:
I found housing through housinganywhere.
That was easy.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It was not possible to live on campus in Vienna

Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: There was a obligatory meeting where we got a signed arrival letter.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The international office at Uni Wien was very helpfull

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got all the classes i wanted. The system in Vienna is a little different and wierd. But it is always possible to ask a professer to join a class, even if it might be full. I did not experience an elective class was full.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Register for as many classes as possible and de-registre after to be sure you get enough classes and that your schedule will add up.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I did electives with was both BA and MA. They were easier than in CPH

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Easier. They give grades for attendance so all attendance is mandatory.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
Be sociale and join ESN groups. 
Perhaps find a flat with roommates through facebook groups etc. 
Use the weekends for trips to other cities.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Take the german course in the beginning of the semester. I met so many friends through that. If you pass its only €150

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting friends from other countries and improving my german.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Being away from home and sometimes missing my life in CPH
